column1: # Security-by-design: All security headers are configured by default.
# Rules are only ignored after investigation, with the verdict documented
# below - if ZAP reports anything else, investigate it first.
# - CORS: restricted via CORS_ORIGINS env var
# - 90005: ZAP's own requests omit the browser-only Sec-Fetch-* headers;
#   the alert reflects the scanner's requests, not a server misconfiguration.
# - 10094: the flagged base64 string is the per-request CSP nonce
#   (32 random bytes, by design - see public/index.php nonce generation).
# - 10049: the flagged max-age=31536000 responses are the deliberate
#   cacheable 301 HTTP->HTTPS redirects (documented in the nginx templates).

column3: (Sec-Fetch headers are request-side; scanner requests lack them by nature)
